title: Workspace Overview & Quick Start
description: Interactive walkthrough with an intro screen, pinned hotspots, and Webflow publishing.

steps.title: Welcome to BxLearn Analytics
steps.body: Take a quick interactive walkthrough to see how teams build, organize, and embed product demos in Webflow.

steps.title: Create a New Workspace
steps.body: Click the pulsing hotspot on "+ New Workspace" to spin up a dedicated folder hierarchy for your team.

steps.title: Inspect Live Conversion Metrics
steps.body: Track real-time completion rates and engagement across every embedded walkthrough.

steps.title: Publish Directly to Webflow
steps.body: Click "Publish to Webflow" in the top-right corner to copy your ready-to-paste embed snippet.

steps.title: Ready to Build Your Own Demo?
steps.body: Upload any screen recording, drop hotspots or text screens onto the timeline, and embed it in Webflow in seconds.
